# Hook: verify-traceability

Verify every implemented product requirement has coverage evidence before SDD change closure, and dry-run the promotion before a Product Change is promoted.

GitHub Copilot has no hook runtime, so this guard is documentation: run the commands
below yourself (or in CI) at the described moments.

## before-sdd-closure

```bash
prodshape coverage check ${sdd-change-dir}
```

## before-promotion

```bash
prodshape change promote ${change} --dry-run
```

The dry run reports the plan; executing the promotion remains an explicit human action and is never performed by a hook.
